GIS - Tuscola County
GIS
A Geographic Information System (GIS) lets us visualize, question, analyze, and interpret data to understand relationships, patterns, and trends.
Tuscola County GIS provides mapping support to a host of Township and County offices.
Our office will be closed Monday, 7/3/2023, and Tuesday, 7/4/2023.
-->
FETCH GIS PLATFORM
To view approximate property boundaries*, library and school districts, FEMA flood zones, and more check out our FetchGIS system.
Reports on property assessment values, sales and tax history, and more may be purchased within. FetchGIS is available on mobile and desktop devices and can be found by visiting tuscolacounty.org/fetch
or clicking on the FetchGIS tile under "Frequently Accessed".
*FetchGIS boundary lines are not field verified and should not be used to solve property disputes.
It is recommended to consult with a professional surveyor when authoritative property lines are desired.
here or click on the new tile under "Frequently Accessed".-->
PLAT, TAX MAPS & SURVEYS
Plat Maps are available for purchase at our Register of Deeds’ office with the proceeds supporting our local 4-H program.
A selection of Tax Maps can be found on our Treasurer’s webpage .
Subdivision Plats are available at the LARA website .
Registered surveys may be viewed at our Register of Deeds’ Land Record Search site .
MAP PRINTS
The GIS Department is capable of producing a variety of maps both digital and physical. Sizes range from 8.5” x 11” – Letter to larger formatted prints.
DATA PURCHASES
Datasets such as parcel boundaries, aerial imagery, and other data maintained by the GIS Department are available for purchase. Contact our office at chorton@tuscolacounty.org for more information.
GIS PRICING GUIDE
To view prices for the products and services offered by the Tuscola County GIS Department please see our Pricing Guide available HERE .
POLICIES AND AGREEMENTS
To view policies and purchase agreements related to obtaining Tuscola County GIS data click HERE .

Parcel Drafter
The Tuscola County Parcel Drafter is a free resource designed to assist in mapping parcel descriptions. Featured in the app are a parcel layer with basic
ownership information and a “Red Star” problems layer. You can click on either a parcel or a red star to see basic info about it. This tool also allows
you to input metes and bounds descriptions into the system and instantly see each line mapped against the current county parcel layer.
To begin click Start New Traverse and click the point at which the description commences. You can then input the direction and distance using the
format n90-00-00e. You can also click the square Digitize button to input the distance and direction by hand. You can access the Parcel Drafter in the
frequently accessed tiles, or here -->
